description: This PHP class defines the entity 'LeavePeriodHistory' for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the database table 'ohrm_leave_period_history'. It includes properties for start month, start day, and creation date, along with getter and setter methods. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping, and incorporates a decorator trait.

classes.name: LeavePeriodHistory
classes.description: Represents a record of leave period start information with associated metadata, mapped to the corresponding database table in the ORM system.
